stem: Which idea is suggested in BOTH the story “Biking for Boots” and the selection “The Ride of a Lifetime!”?
instruction: Use “Biking for Boots” and “The Ride of a Lifetime!” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: A long trip is likely to include both difficult and wonderful moments.

options.label: B
options.text: A great deal of preparation is needed in order to make a successful trip.

options.label: C
options.text: Taking a long trip is a good way to see important historical places.

options.label: D
options.text: People going on trips should travel in large groups in case there is trouble.
